description: How to take a workspace's code out of CodeGene when CodeGene keeps it (a workspace with no GitHub): links that download the whole codebase as a zip or tar.gz (send them to the person: they open in their signed-in browser, you get no bytes), and how to clone it or copy it to their own GitHub with create_code_token. A workspace whose code is already in its own GitHub says so. Only owners and admins can take the code.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: export_code
title: Take the code
